svg.title: The Vault reader showing the note Feature tour
svg.desc: The floating Vault reader showing the sample note Feature tour, from its top to its table: the bar with the note's name, Keep and Close; the properties status draft, project herdr, tags #herdr and #plan/reader, aliases Tour and Everything, created 2026-11-02; the heading Feature tour; a paragraph with bold, italic, highlighted, struck and inline code text and two tags; a line of wikilinks drawn as links (one unresolved, in italics); the callouts Note, Folded warning (closed), Open tip with a nested example, and Done with a checked task; the task list with its six marks; and the Feature / Shown as table. Drawn from the mods' own layout code, icons and the Herdr graphite theme, with the sample vault's content; a drawing, not a screenshot.
